title: layr line list --json
description: The local lines of the project, sorted by name. A name pattern argument filters the list. 'layr line new --json' writes one item of this list (with --count, an array of them).

id.description: A layr id (a state, line or machine) in UUID form.
The id of the line. It stays the same when the line is renamed.

head.description: The id of the state at the head of the line.

owner.description: The user id (uid) of the owner of the line.

machine.description: The id of the machine that holds the working folder of the line.

path.description: The absolute path of the working folder of the line on this machine. The folder can be absent, for example for a line of another machine.
